newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer joins Merrill Lynch as commods counsel.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer joins Merrill Lynch as commods counsel.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc announced Tuesday that Ronald S. Oppenheimer has joined the investment bank as general counsel of Merrill Lynch Futures Inc.

In this capacity, Oppenheimer will be responsible for all matters related to futures and commodities regulation and will report to Carlos M. Morales, general counsel for the corporate and institutional client group.
Prior to joining Merrill Lynch, Oppenheimer was executive vice president and general counsel at the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX), after joining the exchange in 1988.
Oppenheimer has also worked for the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) as a trial attorney and as an associate with the New York law firm, Skadden Arps Slate Meagher and Flom.
